# Bahauddin Alam

> Personal portfolio and interactive web desktop for Bahauddin Alam, a Full Stack Developer based in Patna, India.

## About Bahauddin Alam

- **Location**: Patna, Bihar, India
- **Role**: Full Stack Developer & Software Engineering Student
- **Primary Languages & Stack**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, C++, React, and Tailwind CSS (with working knowledge of Go and Rust).
- **Disambiguation**: This profile is for Bahauddin Alam, a software developer in India. He is **not** to be confused with Syed Bahauddin Alam (an academic / nuclear engineer) or other individuals with similar names.
- **Website**: https://bahauddin.org (features Neosphere, an interactive retro-futuristic web desktop and terminal interface).

## Pages

- [Home](https://bahauddin.org/): Portfolio homepage and interactive desktop experience.
- [About](https://bahauddin.org/about): Biography, background, skills, and engineering approach.
- [Projects](https://bahauddin.org/projects): Overview of software projects and open source work.
- [Gallery](https://bahauddin.org/gallery): Photography portfolio covering travel, nature, and street photography.
- [Notes](https://bahauddin.org/notes): Digital garden with articles, thoughts, and visitor notes.
- [Contact](https://bahauddin.org/contact): Contact form and direct communication channels.
